correctness.rationale: The Pappus LCF graph and neighborhood-avoidance face condition are exact and correct. My separate 18-bit face enumeration produced 118562 nonempty faces and the stated nonpure vector; I reconstructed 59279 unique toggling pairs with one critical vertex, two critical dimension-8 cells and one critical dimension-9 cell. An independent topological sort of the entire directed Hasse diagram exhausted 900162 cover relations. Independently signed integral Morse projection gives zero 1×2 d9, not just rank over a field. Since the 8-sphere wedge is 7-connected and π8 ≅ H8=Z², the attaching map of the nine-cell is null, yielding integral 2S8∨S9. Verification applies only to this finite explicit graph.

value.rationale: The canonical 18-vertex Pappus incidence graph is a natural nonchordal test of dominance-complex homotopy; its exactly mixed 8/9-dimensional integral wedge is not determined by general forest/chordal theory. The exact attaching-map vanishing is a meaningful homotopy invariant and provides a reproducible benchmark for Alexander-dual graph-complex methods.

limitations: Only fixed Pappus dominance complex, not a family classification; signed full finite Hasse/Morse check independently reproduced but no independent formal Lean/expert certification. Possible unindexed equivalent earlier computation.
